questions.korean: 회의 시간을 조정할 수 있을까요?
answers: Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?
Could we look at finding another time for the meeting?
questions.hint: Would it be possible to / Could we = 가능할까요?

questions.korean: 그 안건을 다음 회의로 미룹시다.
answers: Let's table that item for the next meeting.
Let's carry that over to the next meeting.
questions.hint: table / carry over = 다음으로 미루다

questions.korean: 그 제안의 장단점을 따져봐야 해.
answers: We need to weigh the pros and cons of the proposal.
We should consider the advantages and disadvantages.
questions.hint: weigh the pros and cons = 장단점을 따지다

questions.korean: 그것에 대한 우리 입장을 명확히 해야 해.
answers: We need to clarify our stance on that.
We should make our position clear on this matter.
questions.hint: clarify our stance / make our position clear

questions.korean: 그 결정은 이사회의 승인이 필요해.
answers: The decision requires board approval.
That needs to be approved by the board of directors.
questions.hint: requires board approval / approved by the board

questions.korean: 그는 분명히 그 결과를 알고 있었을 거야.
answers: He must certainly have known the outcome.
He was undoubtedly aware of the result.
questions.hint: must certainly / undoubtedly = 분명히 ~임에 틀림없다

questions.korean: 그게 사실일 가능성은 거의 없어.
answers: There is little chance that it is true.
It's highly unlikely to be true.
questions.hint: little chance / highly unlikely = 가능성이 거의 없다

questions.korean: 아마도 그는 이미 알고 있을 거야.
answers: In all likelihood, he already knows.
Chances are he's already aware.
questions.hint: in all likelihood / chances are = 아마도

questions.korean: 그 주장은 어느 정도 타당성이 있어.
answers: The argument has some validity.
There is some merit to that claim.
questions.hint: some validity / merit to = 어느 정도 타당성

questions.korean: 그 결과는 예측 불가능해.
answers: The outcome is impossible to predict.
There's no telling what the result will be.
questions.hint: impossible to predict / no telling = 예측 불가능하다
questions.explanation: there's no telling = 알 수 없다, 예측 불가

questions.korean: 그냥 몸 풀려고 했어. (긴장 풀기)
answers: I was just trying to break the ice.
I was just loosening up.
questions.hint: break the ice = 어색함을 없애다, 분위기를 풀다

questions.korean: 그건 완전 엉터리야.
answers: That's total garbage.
That's absolute nonsense.
questions.hint: total garbage / absolute nonsense = 완전 엉터리
questions.explanation: garbage = 쓰레기 같은 말, nonsense = 말도 안 되는 것

questions.korean: 솔직히, 그는 완전 잘났어. (비꼼)
answers: Honestly, he thinks he's all that.
He's so full of himself.
questions.hint: think you're all that / full of himself = 잘난 척하다

questions.korean: 그들은 결국 사이가 나빠졌어.
answers: They ended up falling out.
They eventually had a falling-out.
questions.hint: fall out = 사이가 나빠지다

questions.korean: 그것 때문에 내 하루가 망쳤어.
answers: That totally ruined my day.
It threw off my whole day.
questions.hint: ruined my day / threw off my day = 하루를 망치다

questions.korean: 그 두 가지를 동시에 추구하는 것 사이에 긴장감이 있어.
answers: There is a tension between pursuing both at the same time.
There's an inherent conflict in trying to achieve both simultaneously.
questions.hint: tension between / inherent conflict = 긴장감, 내재된 갈등

questions.korean: 그 개념은 아직 명확하게 정의되지 않았어.
answers: The concept has not yet been clearly defined.
That notion remains vaguely articulated.
questions.hint: not yet been defined / remains vaguely articulated

questions.korean: 그것은 더 깊은 구조적 문제를 반영해.
answers: It reflects a deeper structural issue.
That points to a more fundamental underlying problem.
questions.hint: reflects / points to = 반영하다, 가리키다

questions.korean: 그 현상은 다양한 요소들이 복합적으로 작용해.
answers: The phenomenon is driven by a complex interplay of factors.
Multiple forces converge to produce that effect.
questions.hint: interplay of factors / forces converge = 복합적 작용
questions.explanation: interplay = 복잡한 상호 작용, converge = 수렴하다

questions.korean: 그 차이는 생각보다 미묘해.
answers: The difference is more subtle than it appears.
The distinction is more nuanced than one might think.
questions.hint: subtle / nuanced = 미묘한

questions.korean: 다시 말해서, 우리는 처음부터 다시 시작해야 해.
answers: In other words, we need to start from scratch.
To rephrase it, we're back to square one.
questions.hint: in other words / to rephrase = 다시 말해서
questions.explanation: back to square one = 원점으로 돌아가다

questions.korean: 이게 무슨 말이냐면, 더 많은 자원이 필요하다는 거야.
answers: What this means is that we need more resources.
The implication here is that additional resources are required.
questions.hint: What this means is that / the implication is that

questions.korean: 이 점을 더 구체적으로 설명하자면
answers: To elaborate on this point
To be more specific about this
questions.hint: to elaborate on / to be more specific = 더 구체적으로 설명하자면

questions.korean: 전반적으로 볼 때, 그 전략은 효과가 있어.
answers: Overall, the strategy seems to be working.
On the whole, the approach is proving effective.
questions.hint: overall / on the whole = 전반적으로

questions.korean: 달리 말하자면, 그건 시간 낭비야.
answers: Put differently, it's a waste of time.
In other words, we're spinning our wheels.
questions.hint: put differently = 달리 말하자면
questions.explanation: spin one's wheels = 헛바퀴를 돌리다, 헛수고하다

questions.korean: 불평등 문제는 다각도로 접근해야 해.
answers: The issue of inequality must be addressed from multiple angles.
Inequality is a multifaceted issue that requires a comprehensive approach.
questions.hint: from multiple angles / multifaceted = 다각도로, 다면적인

questions.korean: 그 정책은 가장 취약한 계층에 불균형적으로 영향을 미쳐.
answers: The policy disproportionately affects the most vulnerable populations.
It has an unequal impact on the most marginalized groups.
questions.hint: disproportionately / unequal impact = 불균형적으로 영향을 미치다

questions.korean: 그 문제에 대한 인식이 높아지고 있어.
answers: Awareness of the issue is growing.
There is a rising awareness of this problem.
questions.hint: awareness of / rising awareness = 인식이 높아지다

questions.korean: 모든 이해관계자들이 해결책 마련에 참여해야 해.
answers: All stakeholders must be involved in finding a solution.
Every party with a stake in this should participate in developing a fix.
questions.hint: stakeholders / all parties = 이해관계자

questions.korean: 그것은 단기적 해결책에 불과해.
answers: That is merely a short-term solution.
It's nothing more than a temporary fix.
questions.hint: merely / nothing more than = ~에 불과하다

questions.korean: 그럼에도 불구하고, 그들은 앞으로 나아갔어.
answers: Nevertheless, they pressed on.
Nonetheless, they moved forward.
questions.hint: nevertheless / nonetheless = 그럼에도 불구하고

questions.korean: 이와는 대조적으로, 두 번째 그룹은 훨씬 나은 결과를 냈어.
answers: In contrast, the second group performed significantly better.
By contrast, the other group achieved far superior results.
questions.hint: in contrast / by contrast = 이와는 대조적으로

questions.korean: 그 결과적으로, 전체 시스템이 재설계됐어.
answers: Consequently, the entire system was redesigned.
As a consequence, the whole framework had to be overhauled.
questions.hint: consequently / as a consequence = 그 결과로

questions.korean: 앞서 언급했듯이, 그 문제는 복잡해.
answers: As previously mentioned, the problem is complex.
As noted earlier, this is a complicated matter.
questions.hint: as previously mentioned / as noted earlier = 앞서 언급했듯이

questions.korean: 이런 맥락에서, 그 결정은 이해가 돼.
answers: In this context, the decision makes sense.
Given this backdrop, the choice is understandable.
questions.hint: in this context / given this backdrop = 이런 맥락에서

questions.korean: 그 변화는 여러 복합적 요인의 결과야.
answers: The change is the result of multiple compounding factors.
It stems from a combination of complex factors.
questions.hint: stem from / result of = ~에서 비롯되다

questions.korean: 그 결정은 돌이킬 수 없는 결과를 낳았어.
answers: The decision led to irreversible consequences.
That choice resulted in consequences that couldn't be undone.
questions.hint: led to / resulted in = ~을 초래했다

questions.korean: 그것이 도미노 효과를 일으켰어.
answers: It triggered a domino effect.
That set off a chain reaction.
questions.hint: trigger a domino effect / set off a chain reaction = 연쇄 반응을 일으키다

questions.korean: 그 여러 요인들이 수렴해서 위기를 만들었어.
answers: Several factors converged to create the crisis.
A confluence of issues gave rise to the crisis.
questions.hint: converge / confluence = 수렴하다, 한 점에 모이다

questions.korean: 그것은 더 광범위한 패턴의 증상일 뿐이야.
answers: It is merely a symptom of a broader pattern.
This is just one manifestation of a wider trend.
questions.hint: symptom of / manifestation of = ~의 증상, 표현

questions.korean: 그가 그걸 모른다는 게 말이 안 돼.
answers: It doesn't make sense that he doesn't know about it.
There's no way he's unaware of it.
questions.hint: it doesn't make sense that / there's no way = 말이 안 된다

questions.korean: 이 시점에서, 우리가 할 수 있는 최선은 손해를 최소화하는 거야.
answers: At this point, the best we can do is minimize the damage.
Given where we are now, damage control is the priority.
questions.hint: at this point / given where we are = 이 시점에서

questions.korean: 설령 그게 사실이라 해도, 그건 충분한 이유가 되지 않아.
answers: Even if that were true, it wouldn't be sufficient justification.
Granted that it's true, it still doesn't justify the action.
questions.hint: even if ~ were true / granted that = 설령 ~라 해도

questions.korean: 최악의 경우, 우리는 처음부터 다시 시작해야 할 수도 있어.
answers: In the worst case scenario, we might have to start over.
Worst case, we could be back to square one.
questions.hint: in the worst case scenario = 최악의 경우
questions.explanation: start over / back to square one = 처음부터 다시

questions.korean: 그게 성공한다는 보장이 없어.
answers: There's no guarantee it will succeed.
Success is far from guaranteed.
questions.hint: no guarantee / far from guaranteed = 보장이 없다

questions.korean: 나는 그 결정에 대해 양가적 감정을 느껴.
answers: I have ambivalent feelings about the decision.
I'm torn about that decision.
questions.hint: ambivalent / torn = 양가적 감정을 가진
questions.explanation: ambivalent = 두 가지 상반된 감정을 동시에 느끼는

questions.korean: 그것은 나를 당혹스럽게 만들어.
answers: It leaves me at a loss.
It leaves me baffled.
questions.hint: at a loss / baffled = 당혹스러운, 어쩔 줄 모르는

questions.korean: 그 소식에 나는 복잡한 심경이야.
answers: The news leaves me with mixed feelings.
I have conflicting emotions about the news.
questions.hint: mixed feelings / conflicting emotions = 복잡한 심경

questions.korean: 나는 그것에 완전히 압도됐어.
answers: I was completely overwhelmed by it.
It left me utterly floored.
questions.hint: overwhelmed / floored = 압도된

questions.korean: 그 말은 마음에 깊이 와 닿았어.
answers: Those words really hit home.
That deeply resonated with me.
questions.hint: hit home / resonate with = 깊이 와 닿다
